question: _______________ is commonly known as imperfect fungi because only the asexual or vegetative phases of these fungi are known.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Deuteromycetes.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Deuteromycetes** commonly called **moulds** are **“second-class” fungi that have no known sexual state in their life cycle, and thus reproduce only by producing spores via mitosis**.
 
• **Deuteromycetes** are also known as **imperfect fungi. **
 
• They show only the asexual phase and **do not show sexual reproduction.**
 
• They reproduce asexually by forming** conidia**.
 
• Deuteromycetes are commonly known as** imperfect fungi because only their vegetative and asexual phases are known. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phycomycetes** are **an obsolete polyphyletic taxon for certain fungi with aseptate hyphae**. 

 
 
• Asexual reproduction occurs by **zoospores(motile) or by Aplanospores(non-motile). **
 
• These spores are endogenously generated in the** sporangium.**** **
 
 
 
• **Basidiomycota** is **a important lineage of fungi embracing more than 40,000 species accounting for roughly 1/3 of fungal species**. 
 
 
• It comprises important groups such as **mushrooms, plant pathogenetic smut, rust, and industrially important yeast.**
 
 
 
• **Ascomycota** is a** phylum of the kingdom Fungi** that, combined with the Basidiomycota, forms the sub kingdom **Dikarya.**
 
• Its members are generally called as** sac fungi or ascomycetes.**
